export const KIN_TERM_ROWS: Array<{ lang: 'en' | 'hi' | 'ta' | 'bn'; relation_key: string; term: string; gloss: string }> =
  (Object.keys(TERMS) as Array<keyof typeof TERMS>).flatMap(lang =>
    Object.entries(TERMS[lang]).map(([relation_key, row]) => ({ lang, relation_key, ...row })),
  );

export function resolveTerms(relationKey: string): {
  en: TermRow; hi: TermRow; ta: TermRow; bn: TermRow; gloss: string;
} {
  const pick = (lang: keyof typeof TERMS): TermRow =>
    TERMS[lang][relationKey] ?? { term: relationKey, gloss: '' };
  const en = pick('en');
  return { en, hi: pick('hi'), ta: pick('ta'), bn: pick('bn'), gloss: en.gloss };
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Live-server QA for SC1 (generations), SC2 (kinship), SC3 (RBAC), plus the

# `curl -i` captured under qa/transcripts/.
set -euo pipefail
BASE=http://127.0.0.1:8788
QA_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
T="$QA_DIR/transcripts"
mkdir -p "$T" "$QA_DIR/jars"

step() { echo -e "\n===== $* ====="; }
fail() { echo "ASSERTION FAILED: $*" >&2; exit 1; }

jget() { node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c).on('end',()=>{const j=JSON.parse(d);const v='$1'.split('.').reduce((o,k)=>o?.[k],j);console.log(v===undefined||v===null?'':typeof v==='object'?JSON.stringify(v):v)})"; }

for u in meena priya-outsider; do :; done
